inlines.v: DISPLODE, verb transitive [Latin , to break forth.] To vent, discharge or burst with a violent sound. In posture to displode their second tire of thunder. DISPLODE, verb intransitive To burst with a loud report; to explode; as, a meteor diploded with a tremendous sound.
